_comment: Two sections. 'edges' is per-edge ledger prose only, keyed GIVER>TAKER by roster code — the adjacency GRAPH is never read from here; it comes live from the synced DomainConfig.Adjacency, so a rewired server draws its own web. 'roads' DO contribute edges: cross-calling co-grants written in the domain code itself (TemDomain.TechTemporalKill, FarDomain.TechButchery — both ruled 2026-08-21), kept here against the-quire-site's working callings copy. A road with a 'requires' modid only draws when that mod is enabled.
